name: Nguyen Thi Mai Linh
headline: Senior Project Manager | Agile & Scrum Delivery Leader
summary: Senior Project Manager with 9 years of experience leading cross-functional software delivery teams across fintech and e-commerce sectors. Skilled in Agile and Scrum methodologies, stakeholder management, and driving projects from initiation through successful delivery. Proven ability to align business objectives with technical execution while managing budgets, timelines, and risk.

responsibilities: Lead delivery of enterprise fintech platforms using Scrum and Kanban frameworks
Manage stakeholder communication across executive, client, and engineering teams
Oversee project budgets ranging from $500K to $2M
Coordinate release planning and sprint retrospectives with distributed teams
Mitigate project risks through proactive planning and contingency strategies
Managed end-to-end delivery of e-commerce platform upgrades
Facilitated daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and backlog grooming sessions
Coordinated with UX, QA, and development teams to ensure timely releases
Prepared status reports and presented progress updates to senior stakeholders
Supported project managers in tracking timelines and deliverables
Assisted in documenting requirements and meeting minutes
Coordinated logistics for client meetings and internal workshops
